title: Show comparable supplier quote price history
description: Add a development-only read-only price-history workspace for persisted purchase quotes. Compare only the same product, specification, unit, currency and tax-included basis; show approval/selection as evidence, never auto-select a supplier or change quotes, orders or prices. Do not execute migration, production SQL, real database operations or deployment.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded authenticated GET history query filters by product and optional supplier/date, excludes soft-deleted rows, and uses stable date/id ordering.

Rows preserve supplier, currency, unit, specification, tax basis and approval/selection context; price differences are calculated only within matching comparison groups, with incompatible rows clearly separated.
The purchase-quote page opens a read-only history view from a quote row with server-side filtering and explicit empty/truncated states.
Focused unit tests cover grouping, bounds, filtering and no-write semantics; the safe Release build passes, and the comparison rules are documented.
